scope: Extant five-domed Star Mosque in Armanitola, with its eastern arched verandah, tiled ornament and mapped forecourt star fountain.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Shah Alam Zahiruddin records the 1987 sideways expansion toward the north, two added domes, earlier east verandah, larger pavement forecourt and added fountain.
The agency names Star Mosque as the site of the ambassador’s 1 November 2021 visit.
Architectural entry records white domes with blue stars and the length and breadth of the prayer-hall building without adjoining areas.

next: Build the east arcade, five alternating domes, pale tile with original star geometry, and mapped forecourt fountain.
